    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def copy_to_list(self, request, pk=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Copy this item to another grocery list."""
        item = self.get_object()
        target_list_id = request.data.get("target_list_id")
        if not target_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "target_list_id is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        try:
            target_list = GroceryList.objects.get(id=target_list_id)
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Target list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        # Verify same family
        if target_list.family_id != item.grocery_list.family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Cannot copy to a list in a different family"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        max_position = (
            GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list=target_list).aggregate(
                max_pos=models.Max("position")
            )["max_pos"]
            or -1
        )
        new_item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
            grocery_list=target_list,
            name=item.name,
            description=item.description,
            quantity=item.quantity,
            unit=item.unit,
            weight_amount=item.weight_amount,
            weight_unit=item.weight_unit,
            category=item.category,
            grocery_category=_category_for_target_list(
                item.grocery_category, target_list
            ),
            planned_store=item.planned_store,
            trip_only=item.trip_only,
            position=max_position + 1,
            created_by=request.user,
        )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.copy_to_list",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response(
            GroceryItemSerializer(new_item).data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def move_to_list(self, request, pk=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Move this item to another grocery list."""
        item = self.get_object()
        target_list_id = request.data.get("target_list_id")
        if not target_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "target_list_id is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        try:
            target_list = GroceryList.objects.get(id=target_list_id)
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Target list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if target_list.family_id != item.grocery_list.family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Cannot move to a list in a different family"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        max_position = (
            GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list=target_list).aggregate(
                max_pos=models.Max("position")
            )["max_pos"]
            or -1
        )
        item.grocery_list = target_list
        item.grocery_category = _category_for_target_list(
            item.grocery_category, target_list
        )
        item.position = max_position + 1
        item.save(
            update_fields=["grocery_list", "grocery_category", "position", "updated_at"]
        )

        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.move_to_list",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response(GroceryItemSerializer(item).data)


class GroceryStoreViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ViewSet):
    """ViewSet for family grocery stores (canonical + alias-backed)."""

    required_feature = "groceries"

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def list(self, request):
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response([])

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        stores = GroceryStore.objects.filter(
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).order_by("name")
        serializer = GroceryStoreSerializer(stores, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)

    def create(self, request):
        serializer = GroceryStoreCreateSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        family_id = serializer.validated_data["family"]
        raw_name = serializer.validated_data["name"]

        try:
            family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
        except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Family not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family=family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        from .services import GroceryStoreResolverService

        store, created = GroceryStoreResolverService.resolve_or_create_store(
            family=family,
            raw_name=raw_name,
            user=request.user,
            allow_create=True,
        )
        output = GroceryStoreSerializer(store)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="grocery_store.create",
            outcome="success",
            store_id=str(store.id),
        )
        return Response(
            output.data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED if created else status.HTTP_200_OK,
        )


class GroceryCategoryViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    """
    ViewSet for managing family-scoped grocery categories.

    On list, auto-creates default categories for the family if none exist.
    """

    required_feature = "groceries"

    serializer_class = GroceryCategorySerializer
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self):
        user = self.request.user
        user_family_ids = list(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True).values_list(  # type: ignore[misc]
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )
        if not user_family_ids:
            return GroceryCategory.objects.none()

        queryset = GroceryCategory.objects.filter(family_id__in=user_family_ids)

        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        list_type = self.request.query_params.get("list_type")
        if list_type:
            queryset = queryset.filter(list_type=list_type)

        return queryset

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        """List categories, auto-creating defaults if needed."""
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        list_type = request.query_params.get("list_type")
        if family_id:
            user_id = request.user.id
            if user_id is None:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Authentication required"},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )

            if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                user_id=user_id,
                family_id=family_id,
                is_active=True,
            ).exists():
                return Response(
                    {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )
            try:
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
                if list_type:
                    GroceryCategory.ensure_defaults_for_family(
                        family, list_type=list_type
                    )
            except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Family not found"},
                    status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                )
        return super().list(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def update(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        """Disallow moving categories across families."""
        instance = self.get_object()
        if "family" in request.data and str(request.data["family"]) != str(
            instance.family_id
        ):
            return Response(
                {"error": "family cannot be changed"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        response = super().update(request, *args, **kwargs)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="grocery_category.update",
            outcome="success",
            category_id=str(instance.id),
        )
        return response

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        family = serializer.validated_data["family"]
        user_id = self.request.user.id
        if user_id is None:
            raise PermissionDenied("Authentication required")

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user_id=user_id,
            family=family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied("You are not a member of this family")

        serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_category.create",
            outcome="success",
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_category.delete",
            outcome="success",
        )
        instance.delete()


class AggregateGroceryListView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    Read-only aggregate view of all grocery items across all lists for a family.

    Returns items with store chip labels for the aggregate view.
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "family query parameter is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        items = (
            mobile_visible_item_queryset(
                GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list__family_id=family_id)
            )
            .select_related(
                "grocery_list",
                "grocery_list__store",
                "planned_store",
                "category",
                "grocery_category",
                "assigned_to",
                "created_by",
            )
            .prefetch_related("labels")
            .order_by("grocery_list__name", "position")
        )

        data = []
        for item in items:
            item_data = GroceryItemSerializer(item).data
            # Add aggregate-specific fields
            item_data["list_name"] = item.grocery_list.name
            item_data["list_id"] = str(item.grocery_list.id)
            # Store chip: prefer planned_store > list store > list name
            if item.planned_store:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.planned_store.name
            elif item.grocery_list.store:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.grocery_list.store.name
            else:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.grocery_list.name
            data.append(item_data)

        return Response(data)


class ActiveTripContextView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    View to get the active trip context for a family.

    Returns the currently active trip (if any) and whether it has a grocery list.
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})

        # Match the list endpoint's non-explosive behavior when the client
        # holds an inaccessible family context.
        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user, family_id=family_id, is_active=True
        ).exists():
            return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})

        # Find active trip (current date falls within trip dates)
        from trips.models import Trip

        today = timezone.now().date()
        active_trip = (
            Trip.objects.filter(
                tripfamilygroups__familygroup_id=family_id,
                tripfamilygroups__status=TripFamilyGroups.STATUS_ACCEPTED,
                start_date__lte=today,
                end_date__gte=today,
                deleted_at__isnull=True,
            )
            .distinct()
            .first()
        )

        if active_trip:
            # Check if trip has a grocery list in new system
            has_list = GroceryList.objects.filter(
                family_id=family_id, trip=active_trip
            ).exists()

            serializer = ActiveTripContextSerializer(
                {"trip": active_trip, "has_grocery_list": has_list}
            )
            return Response(serializer.data)

        return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})


class FamilyProductPreferenceViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    """
    ViewSet for managing family product preferences.

    Provides CRUD operations for product preferences with family-based access control.
    Includes actions for managing brands and photos.
    """

    required_feature = "groceries"
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_serializer_class(self):
        if self.action == "create":
            return FamilyProductPreferenceCreateSerializer
        if self.action == "list":
            return FamilyProductPreferenceSummarySerializer
        return FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer

    def create(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        """Create a product preference and return full serialized response."""
        serializer = self.get_serializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)

        # Return full response using FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer
        response_serializer = FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer(
            serializer.instance, context=self.get_serializer_context()
        )
        headers = self.get_success_headers(response_serializer.data)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="product_preference.create",
            outcome="success",
            preference_id=str(serializer.instance.id) if serializer.instance else "",
        )
        return Response(
            response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, headers=headers
        )

    def get_queryset(self):
        """Get product preferences for the current user's families."""
        user = self.request.user

        user_family_ids = list(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True).values_list(  # type: ignore[misc]
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )

        if not user_family_ids:
            return FamilyProductPreference.objects.none()

        queryset = FamilyProductPreference.objects.filter(
            family_id__in=user_family_ids, is_active=True
        )

        # Optional family filter
        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Optional category filter
        category_id = self.request.query_params.get("category")
        if category_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(category_id=category_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Optional search filter
        search = self.request.query_params.get("search")
        if search:
            queryset = queryset.filter(
                Q(product_name__icontains=search) | Q(brands__name__icontains=search)
            ).distinct()

        return queryset.select_related(
            "family", "category", "created_by"
        ).prefetch_related("brands", "photos")

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        """Create a product preference with the current user as creator."""
        with transaction.atomic():
            preference = serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
            logger.info(
                "Created product preference %s for family %s by user %s",
                preference.id,
                preference.family_id,
                self.request.user.id,
            )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="product_preference.create",
            outcome="success",
            preference_id=str(preference.id),
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        """Soft delete the product preference."""
        instance.is_active = False
        instance.save(update_fields=["is_active", "updated_at"])
        logger.info(
            "Soft-deleted product preference %s by user %s",
            instance.id,
            self.request.user.id,
        )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="product_preference.destroy",
            outcome="success",
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def upload_photo(self, request, pk=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Register a photo URL after S3 upload."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        photo_url = request.data.get("photo_url")

        if not photo_url:
            return Response(
                {"error": "photo_url is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        photo = ProductPreferencePhoto.objects.create(
            product_preference=preference,
            photo_url=photo_url,
            uploaded_by=request.user,
        )

        serializer = ProductPreferencePhotoSerializer(photo)
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["delete"], url_path="photos/(?P<photo_id>[^/.]+)")
    def delete_photo(self, request, pk=None, photo_id=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Delete a photo from the preference."""
        preference = self.get_object()

        try:
            photo = preference.photos.get(id=photo_id)
            photo.delete()
            return Response(status=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        except ProductPreferencePhoto.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Photo not found"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
            )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def add_brand(self, request, pk=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Add a new brand to the preference with auto-ordering."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        name = request.data.get("name")

        if not name:
            return Response(
                {"error": "name is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        # Get next order number
        from django.db import models as db_models

        max_order = (
            preference.brands.aggregate(max_order=db_models.Max("preference_order"))[
                "max_order"
            ]
            or 0
        )

        brand = ProductBrand.objects.create(
            product_preference=preference,
            name=name,
            preference_order=max_order + 1,
            notes=request.data.get("notes", ""),
        )

        serializer = ProductBrandSerializer(brand)
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def reorder_brands(self, request, pk=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Update the order of brands."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        brand_order = request.data.get("brand_order", [])

        if not brand_order:
            return Response(
                {"error": "brand_order is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            for order, brand_id in enumerate(brand_order, start=1):
                preference.brands.filter(id=brand_id).update(preference_order=order)

        return Response({"message": "Brands reordered successfully"})

    @action(detail=True, methods=["delete"], url_path="brands/(?P<brand_id>[^/.]+)")
    def delete_brand(self, request, pk=None, brand_id=None):  # noqa: ARG002
        """Delete a brand from the preference."""
        preference = self.get_object()

        try:
            brand = preference.brands.get(id=brand_id)
            brand.delete()
            return Response(status=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        except ProductBrand.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Brand not found"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
            )

    @action(detail=False, methods=["get"])
    def search(self, request):
        """Search product preferences by name for autocomplete."""
        query = request.query_params.get("q", "")
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")

        if not query or len(query) < 2:
            return Response([])

        queryset = self.get_queryset()

        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)

        results = queryset.filter(product_name__icontains=query)[:10]

        serializer = FamilyProductPreferenceSummarySerializer(results, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)

class CouponLineResolveView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    Resolve matches for a coupon line by creating GroceryItems.

    POST /api/groceries/coupon-lines/{line_id}/resolve-matches/
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, line_id):
        try:
            line = GroceryCouponLine.objects.select_related(
                "coupon_capture__grocery_run__family"
            ).get(id=line_id)
        except GroceryCouponLine.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Coupon line not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        grocery_run = line.coupon_capture.grocery_run

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user, family=grocery_run.family, is_active=True
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        serializer = ResolveMatchesSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        selected_ids = serializer.validated_data["selected_candidate_ids"]
        planned_store_id = serializer.validated_data.get("planned_store_id")
        quantity = serializer.validated_data.get("quantity", 1)
        unit = serializer.validated_data.get("unit", "count")

        created_items = []
        duplicate_warnings = []
        requested_store = None

        if planned_store_id:
            requested_store = GroceryStore.objects.filter(
                id=planned_store_id,
                family=grocery_run.family,
                is_active=True,
            ).first()
            if requested_store is None:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Planned store not found for this family"},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )

        with transaction.atomic():
            candidates = GroceryCouponCandidate.objects.filter(
                id__in=selected_ids, coupon_line=line
            )

            for candidate in candidates:
                # Check for duplicates
                from .services import (
                    CouponScreenshotProcessorService,
                    GroceryStoreResolverService,
                )

                existing = CouponScreenshotProcessorService.check_duplicate_item(
                    grocery_run, candidate.display_name
                )
                if existing:
                    duplicate_warnings.append(
                        f"'{candidate.display_name}' already exists in the list"
                    )

                # Store precedence:
                # 1) explicit planned_store_id from request
                # 2) existing duplicate item's planned store
                # 3) inferred by detected coupon/candidate store name (existing aliases only)
                item_store = requested_store
                if item_store is None and existing and existing.planned_store_id:
                    item_store = existing.planned_store
                if item_store is None:
                    detected_store = candidate.store_name or line.store_name
                    if detected_store:
                        item_store = GroceryStoreResolverService.resolve_store(
                            family=grocery_run.family,
                            raw_name=detected_store,
                        )

                # Idempotent: get_or_create resolution
                resolution, created = GroceryCouponLineResolution.objects.get_or_create(
                    coupon_line=line,
                    candidate=candidate,
                    defaults={
                        "created_by": request.user,
                    },
                )

                # Only create GroceryItem if resolution was just created
                if created:
                    item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
                        grocery_list=grocery_run,
                        name=candidate.display_name,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        unit=unit,
                        planned_store=item_store,
                        created_by=request.user,
                    )
                    resolution.linked_item = item
                    resolution.save(update_fields=["linked_item"])
                    created_items.append(item)

            # Update line status
            total_candidates = line.candidates.count()
            resolved_count = line.resolutions.count()
            if resolved_count >= total_candidates:
                line.line_status = "resolved"
            elif resolved_count > 0:
                line.line_status = "partially_resolved"
            line.save(update_fields=["line_status"])

        items_serializer = GroceryItemSerializer(
            created_items, many=True, context={"request": request}
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "line_status": line.line_status,
                "created_items": items_serializer.data,
                "duplicate_warnings": duplicate_warnings,
            }
        )

def _get_weekend_summary_signed_cookie(request, summary):
    """Return a redeemed weekend summary token from a signed browser cookie."""
    try:
        return request.get_signed_cookie(
            summary.get_access_cookie_name(),
            default=None,
            salt=summary.ACCESS_COOKIE_SALT,
        )
    except BadSignature:
        logger.warning(
            "Invalid signed weekend summary cookie for summary %s", summary.id
        )
        return None


def _get_weekend_summary_access_token(request, summary):
    """Resolve a weekend summary access token from request metadata."""
    header_token = request.headers.get("X-Weekend-Summary-Token")
    if header_token:
        return header_token, "header"

    query_token = request.GET.get("token")
    if query_token:
        return query_token, "query"

    post_token = request.POST.get("token")
    if post_token:
        return post_token, "post"

    cookie_token = _get_weekend_summary_signed_cookie(request, summary)
    if cookie_token:
        return cookie_token, "cookie"

    return None, None


def _validate_weekend_summary_access_token(summary, token):
    """Return True when the provided JWT grants access to the requested summary."""
    if not token:
        return False

    secure_summary = summary.verify_secure_access_token(token)
    return bool(secure_summary and secure_summary.id == summary.id)


def _clean_weekend_summary_query_string(request):
    """Remove sensitive token parameters before rendering the summary page."""
    clean_query = request.GET.copy()
    clean_query.pop("token", None)
    query_string = clean_query.urlencode()
    return f"{request.path}?{query_string}" if query_string else request.path


def _set_weekend_summary_access_cookie(response, summary, token):
    """Persist redeemed weekend summary access in a signed, httpOnly cookie."""
    response.set_signed_cookie(
        summary.get_access_cookie_name(),
        token,
        salt=summary.ACCESS_COOKIE_SALT,
        httponly=True,
        secure=settings.SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE,
        samesite="Lax",
        path=summary.get_relative_url(),
    )


@login_required
def event_list(request):
    """
    List all events the user has access to with optional filtering
    """
    with child_span("web.events.list.load_events") as load_span:
        # Get all family groups the user is a member of
        family_ids = list(
            request.user.family_memberships.values_list("family_id", flat=True)
        )
        family_groups = FamilyGroup.objects.filter(id__in=family_ids)

        # Get family group types to identify Meta Family groups
        family_types = dict(
            FamilyGroupType.objects.filter(family_id__in=family_ids).values_list(
                "family_id", "type"
            )
        )

        # Separate regular families and meta families
        regular_family_ids = [
            fid for fid in family_ids if family_types.get(fid) != "META"
        ]
        direct_meta_family_ids = [
            fid for fid in family_ids if family_types.get(fid) == "META"
        ]

        # Get all meta family groups the user's regular families are members of
        meta_family_ids = list(
            MetaFamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                family_id__in=regular_family_ids
            ).values_list("meta_family_id", flat=True)
        )

        # Combine all meta family IDs (direct memberships and through regular families)
        all_meta_family_ids = list(set(meta_family_ids + direct_meta_family_ids))

        # Get all families that are members of these meta family groups (the family network)
        # Limit query to prevent performance issues with large networks
        max_network_families = 100
        network_family_ids = list(
            MetaFamilyMembership.objects.filter(meta_family_id__in=all_meta_family_ids)
            .values_list("family_id", flat=True)
            .distinct()[:max_network_families]
        )

        # Ensure we're not missing any families
        all_accessible_family_ids = list(set(family_ids + network_family_ids))

        # Add logging to help debug
        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
        logger.debug(f"User {request.user.id} family_ids: {family_ids}")
        logger.debug(f"User {request.user.id} regular_family_ids: {regular_family_ids}")
        logger.debug(
            f"User {request.user.id} direct_meta_family_ids: {direct_meta_family_ids}"
        )
        logger.debug(
            f"User {request.user.id} all_meta_family_ids: {all_meta_family_ids}"
        )
        logger.debug(f"User {request.user.id} network_family_ids: {network_family_ids}")
        logger.debug(
            f"User {request.user.id} all_accessible_family_ids: {all_accessible_family_ids}"
        )

        # Initialize filter variables
        selected_family = None
        selected_visibility = None
        selected_calendar_type = None
        selected_date_range = None
        selected_participant = None
        selected_month = None
        selected_year = None
        search_query = None  # Initialize search query

        # Get current date for defaults
        today = timezone.now()
        current_month = today.month
        current_year = today.year

        # Generate month and year choices
        month_choices = [
            (1, "January"),
            (2, "February"),
            (3, "March"),
            (4, "April"),
            (5, "May"),
            (6, "June"),
            (7, "July"),
            (8, "August"),
            (9, "September"),
            (10, "October"),
            (11, "November"),
            (12, "December"),
        ]
        year_choices = range(current_year - 1, current_year + 5)

        # Process filter parameters
        if request.method == "GET":
            family_id = request.GET.get("family")
            visibility = request.GET.get("visibility")
            calendar_type = request.GET.get("calendar_type")
            date_range = request.GET.get("date_range")
            participant_id = request.GET.get("participant")
            month = request.GET.get("month")
            year = request.GET.get("year")
            search_query = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()  # Get search query

            if family_id:
                try:
                    selected_family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
                    if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                        user=request.user, family=selected_family
                    ).exists():
                        selected_family = None
                except (FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist, ValueError, DjangoValidationError):
                    selected_family = None

            if visibility in dict(Event.VISIBILITY_CHOICES):
                selected_visibility = visibility

            if calendar_type in ["INTERNAL", "EXTERNAL"]:
                selected_calendar_type = calendar_type

            # Handle date range filtering
            if date_range:
                selected_date_range = date_range

                # Handle month selection
                try:
                    if month and year:
                        selected_month = int(month)
                        selected_year = int(year)
                    else:
                        selected_month = current_month
                        selected_year = current_year
                except ValueError:
                    selected_month = current_month
                    selected_year = current_year

            if participant_id:
                try:
                    participant = User.objects.get(id=participant_id)
                    if participant.family_memberships.filter(
                        family_id__in=family_ids
                    ).exists():
                        selected_participant = participant
                except (User.DoesNotExist, ValueError):
                    selected_participant = None

        # Tentative events shared with user's families
        shared_tentative_event_ids = TentativeEventShare.objects.filter(
            target_family_id__in=family_ids
        ).values_list("event_id", flat=True)
        from events.participation import confirmed_event_queryset_for_user

        confirmed_event_ids = confirmed_event_queryset_for_user(request.user).values(
            "id"
        )

        # Base query filters
        base_filters = (
            Q(family_group_id__in=all_accessible_family_ids, visibility="PUBLIC")
            | Q(participants__user=request.user)
            | Q(creator=request.user)
            | Q(id__in=confirmed_event_ids)
            | Q(id__in=shared_tentative_event_ids)
        )

        # Apply additional filters
        if selected_family:
            base_filters &= Q(family_group=selected_family)

        if selected_visibility:
            base_filters &= Q(visibility=selected_visibility)

        if selected_calendar_type == "INTERNAL":
            base_filters &= Q(internal_calendar__isnull=False)
        elif selected_calendar_type == "EXTERNAL":
            base_filters &= Q(is_external=True)

        # Handle date filtering
        today_date = timezone.now().date()
        now = timezone.now()  # Define now for consistent use
        start_date: date
        end_date: date
        if selected_date_range:
            if selected_date_range == "CURRENT_MONTH":
                start_date = today_date.replace(day=1)
                if today_date.month == 12:
                    end_date = today_date.replace(
                        year=today_date.year + 1, month=1, day=1
                    ) - timedelta(days=1)
                else:
                    end_date = today_date.replace(
                        month=today_date.month + 1, day=1
                    ) - timedelta(days=1)
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time", start_date=start_date, end_date=end_date
                )
            elif selected_date_range == "NEXT_MONTH":
                if today_date.month == 12:
                    start_date = today_date.replace(
                        year=today_date.year + 1, month=1, day=1
                    )
                    end_date = start_date.replace(month=2, day=1) - timedelta(days=1)
                else:
                    start_date = today_date.replace(month=today_date.month + 1, day=1)
                    if today_date.month == 11:
                        end_date = today_date.replace(
                            year=today_date.year + 1, month=1, day=1
                        ) - timedelta(days=1)
                    else:
                        end_date = today_date.replace(
                            month=today_date.month + 2, day=1
                        ) - timedelta(days=1)
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time", start_date=start_date, end_date=end_date
                )
            elif selected_date_range == "CUSTOM" and selected_month and selected_year:
                start_date = datetime(selected_year, selected_month, 1).date()
                if selected_month == 12:
                    end_date = datetime(selected_year + 1, 1, 1).date() - timedelta(
                        days=1
                    )
                else:
                    end_date = datetime(
                        selected_year, selected_month + 1, 1
                    ).date() - timedelta(days=1)
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time", start_date=start_date, end_date=end_date
                )
            elif selected_date_range == "WEEK":
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time",
                    start_date=today_date,
                    end_date=today_date + timedelta(days=7),
                )
            elif selected_date_range == "MONTH":
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time",
                    start_date=today_date,
                    end_date=today_date + timedelta(days=30),
                )
            elif selected_date_range == "YEAR":
                date_filter = build_date_range_q(
                    "start_time",
                    start_date=today_date,
                    end_date=today_date + timedelta(days=365),
                )
            else:
                date_filter = Q()
        else:
            date_filter = Q()

        if selected_participant:
            base_filters &= Q(participants__user=selected_participant)

        # Get base queryset with initial filters applied
        filtered_events = (
            # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
            Event.objects.filter(base_filters)
            .prefetch_related("participants")
            .distinct()
        )

        # Apply PostgreSQL FTS search if query exists
        if search_query:
            # Create a SearchQuery object. Using 'websearch' config allows for more natural language queries.
            # You might need to ensure the 'websearch' config is available in your PostgreSQL setup or use 'english'.
            query = SearchQuery(search_query, config="english", search_type="websearch")
            # Filter the queryset based on the search vector
            # Optionally add ranking: .annotate(rank=SearchRank(F('search_vector'), query)).order_by('-rank')
            filtered_events = filtered_events.filter(search_vector=query)

        # Get upcoming events
        # When a specific date range is selected, don't apply additional future filter
        # as it can exclude valid events within the selected range
        if selected_date_range:
            # Apply only the date filter for the selected range
            upcoming_events = filtered_events.filter(date_filter).order_by(
                "start_time"
            )[:20]
        else:
            # No specific date range, show future events from now
            upcoming_events = (
                filtered_events.filter(
                    date_filter
                )  # date_filter is Q() when no range selected
                .filter(start_time__gte=now)  # Ensure only future/ongoing events
                .order_by("start_time")[:20]
            )

        # Get past events
        if selected_date_range:
            # When date range is selected, show past events within that range
            past_events = (
                filtered_events.filter(date_filter)
                .filter(start_time__lt=now)
                .order_by("-start_time")[:10]
            )
        elif search_query:
            # If searching without date range, include recent past events that match
            past_events = filtered_events.filter(start_time__lt=now).order_by(
                "-start_time"
            )[:10]
        else:
            # Default: show recent past events
            past_events = filtered_events.filter(start_time__lt=now).order_by(
                "-start_time"
            )[:10]

        upcoming_events_list = list(upcoming_events)
        past_events_list = list(past_events)
        all_events = upcoming_events_list + past_events_list
        set_span_attributes(
            load_span,
            event_count=len(all_events),
            upcoming_event_count=len(upcoming_events_list),
            past_event_count=len(past_events_list),
            accessible_family_count=len(all_accessible_family_ids),
            has_search=bool(search_query),
            has_date_range=bool(selected_date_range),
        )

    with child_span(
        "web.events.list.build_calendar_lookups",
        event_count=len(all_events),
    ) as lookup_span:
        external_calendars_dict, internal_calendars_dict = build_calendar_lookup_dicts(
            all_events, request.user, family_ids=all_accessible_family_ids
        )
        request_host = request.get_host()
        set_span_attributes(
            lookup_span,
            internal_calendar_count=len(internal_calendars_dict),
            external_calendar_count=len(
                {cal.id for cal in external_calendars_dict.values()}
            ),
        )

    def hash_to_color(key: str) -> str:
        palette = [
            "#FF6B6B",
            "#4ECDC4",
            "#45B7D1",
            "#96CEB4",
            "#FFEAA7",
            "#DDA5E9",
            "#FF8CC8",
            "#6C5CE7",
        ]
        hash_value = sum(ord(char) for char in key)
        return palette[hash_value % len(palette)]

    with child_span(
        "web.events.list.resolve_member_colors",
        event_count=len(all_events),
    ) as color_span:
        raw_member_colors = get_event_member_colors_batch(
            all_events,
            external_calendars_dict=external_calendars_dict,
            internal_calendars_dict=internal_calendars_dict,
            default_color=None,
        )

        event_colors = {
            str(event.id): (
                raw_member_colors.get(str(event.id)) or hash_to_color(str(event.id))
            )
            for event in all_events
        }
        for event in all_events:
            event.display_color = event_colors.get(str(event.id))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        set_span_attributes(
            color_span,
            resolved_color_count=sum(
                1 for color in raw_member_colors.values() if color is not None
            ),
            fallback_color_count=sum(
                1
                for event in all_events
                if raw_member_colors.get(str(event.id)) is None
            ),
        )

    def _get_child_profile(user: User) -> Child | None:
        prefetched_children = getattr(user, "_prefetched_objects_cache", {}).get(
            "child_profile"
        )
        if prefetched_children is not None:
            return prefetched_children[0] if prefetched_children else None
        return user.child_profile.first()

    def _get_user_avatar_url(user: User) -> str | None:
        with child_span("web.events.list.resolve_user_avatar_url") as avatar_span:
            child_profile = _get_child_profile(user)
            if (
                child_profile
                and child_profile.profile_picture
                and hasattr(child_profile.profile_picture, "name")
                and child_profile.profile_picture.name
            ):
                set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="child_profile_picture")
                return (
                    MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                        child_profile.profile_picture.name,
                        request_host=request_host,
                    )
                    or child_profile.profile_picture.url
                )

            def _avatar_from_social_account(account: object | None) -> str | None:
                if not account:
                    return None
                extra_data = getattr(account, "extra_data", None) or {}
                return extra_data.get("picture") or extra_data.get("avatar_url")

            prefetched_social_accounts = getattr(
                user, "_prefetched_objects_cache", {}
            ).get("socialaccount_set")
            if prefetched_social_accounts is not None:
                google_account = next(
                    (
                        account
                        for account in prefetched_social_accounts
                        if account.provider == "google"
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                avatar_url = _avatar_from_social_account(google_account)
                if avatar_url:
                    set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="prefetched_google")
                    return avatar_url

                if prefetched_social_accounts:
                    set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="prefetched_social")
                    return _avatar_from_social_account(prefetched_social_accounts[0])
            else:
                social_accounts = getattr(user, "socialaccount_set", None)
                if social_accounts is None:
                    set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="none")
                    return None

                google_account = social_accounts.filter(provider="google").first()
                avatar_url = _avatar_from_social_account(google_account)
                if avatar_url:
                    set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="google")
                    return avatar_url

                social_account = social_accounts.first()
                set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="social")
                return _avatar_from_social_account(social_account)

            set_span_attributes(avatar_span, avatar_source="none")
            return None

    def _build_name_parts(name: str, fallback: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
        display_name = name.strip() or fallback.strip() or "Unknown"
        parts = [part for part in display_name.split() if part]
        if not parts:
            return display_name, display_name, ""
        short_name = parts[0]
        if len(parts) == 1:
            initials = parts[0][0].upper()
        else:
            initials = (parts[0][0] + parts[-1][0]).upper()
        return display_name, short_name, initials

    def _build_calendar_users(
        calendar: InternalCalendar | ExternalCalendarAccount,
    ) -> list[dict[str, str | None]]:
        with child_span(
            "web.events.list.build_calendar_users",
            calendar_kind="internal"
            if isinstance(calendar, InternalCalendar)
            else "external",
        ) as users_span:
            users: list[dict[str, str | None]] = []
            associated_user_count = 0
            associated_child_count = 0

            if hasattr(calendar, "associated_users"):
                for assoc_user in calendar.associated_users.all():
                    if not assoc_user.is_active:
                        continue
                    associated_user_count += 1
                    name = assoc_user.get_full_name() or assoc_user.username
                    display_name, short_name, initials = _build_name_parts(
                        name, assoc_user.username
                    )
                    users.append(
                        {
                            "id": str(assoc_user.id),
                            "name": display_name,
                            "short_name": short_name,
                            "initials": initials,
                            "avatar_url": _get_user_avatar_url(assoc_user),
                        }
                    )

            if hasattr(calendar, "associated_children"):
                for child in calendar.associated_children.all():
                    associated_child_count += 1
                    name = child.get_full_name()
                    display_name, short_name, initials = _build_name_parts(
                        name, child.first_name
                    )
                    avatar_url = (
                        MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                            child.profile_picture.name,
                            request_host=request_host,
                        )
                        if child.profile_picture and child.profile_picture.name
                        else None
                    )
                    users.append(
                        {
                            "id": f"child_{child.id}",
                            "name": display_name,
                            "short_name": short_name,
                            "initials": initials,
                            "avatar_url": avatar_url,
                        }
                    )

            set_span_attributes(
                users_span,
                associated_user_count=associated_user_count,
                associated_child_count=associated_child_count,
                rendered_user_count=len(users),
            )
            return users

    def _child_info_from_calendar(
        calendar: InternalCalendar | ExternalCalendarAccount,
    ) -> dict[str, str] | None:
        with child_span(
            "web.events.list.resolve_child_image_url",
            calendar_kind="internal"
            if isinstance(calendar, InternalCalendar)
            else "external",
        ) as child_span_handle:
            if hasattr(calendar, "associated_users"):
                for assoc_user in calendar.associated_users.all():
                    if not assoc_user.is_active:
                        continue
                    child_profile = _get_child_profile(assoc_user)
                    if child_profile and child_profile.profile_picture:
                        picture_name = child_profile.profile_picture.name
                        picture_url = child_profile.profile_picture.url
                        if picture_name:
                            picture_url = (
                                MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                                    picture_name,
                                    request_host=request_host,
                                )
                                or child_profile.profile_picture.url
                            )
                        set_span_attributes(
                            child_span_handle, image_source="associated_user"
                        )
                        return {
                            "name": child_profile.get_full_name(),
                            "picture_url": picture_url,
                        }

            if hasattr(calendar, "associated_children"):
                for child in calendar.associated_children.all():
                    if child.profile_picture:
                        picture_name = child.profile_picture.name
                        picture_url = child.profile_picture.url
                        if picture_name:
                            picture_url = (
                                MediaStorageService.generate_presigned_url(
                                    picture_name,
                                    request_host=request_host,
                                )
                                or child.profile_picture.url
                            )
                        set_span_attributes(
                            child_span_handle, image_source="associated_child"
                        )
                        return {
                            "name": child.get_full_name(),
                            "picture_url": picture_url,
                        }

            set_span_attributes(child_span_handle, image_source="none")
            return None

    # Build child info and calendar metadata
    with child_span(
        "web.events.list.build_child_info",
        event_count=len(all_events),
    ) as child_info_span:
        child_info_by_cal: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}

        for calendar in internal_calendars_dict.values():
            child_info = _child_info_from_calendar(calendar)
            if child_info:
                child_info_by_cal[str(calendar.id)] = child_info

        seen_external_calendars: set[int] = set()
        for calendar in external_calendars_dict.values():
            if calendar.id in seen_external_calendars:
                continue
            seen_external_calendars.add(calendar.id)
            child_info = _child_info_from_calendar(calendar)
            if child_info:
                if calendar.calendar_id:
                    child_info_by_cal[str(calendar.calendar_id)] = child_info
                child_info_by_cal[str(calendar.id)] = child_info

        # Map event IDs to child info
        event_child_info = {}
        for event in all_events:
            calendar_key: str | None = None
            if event.internal_calendar_id:
                calendar_key = str(event.internal_calendar_id)
            elif event.is_external and event.calendar_id:
                calendar_key = str(event.calendar_id)

            if calendar_key and calendar_key in child_info_by_cal:
                event_child_info[event.id] = child_info_by_cal[calendar_key]
        set_span_attributes(
            child_info_span,
            child_info_count=len(event_child_info),
            internal_calendar_count=len(internal_calendars_dict),
            external_calendar_count=len(
                {cal.id for cal in external_calendars_dict.values()}
            ),
        )
    # --- End Fetch associated child info ---

    # --- Populate calendar info with avatar-ready data ---
    with child_span(
        "web.events.list.build_event_calendar_info",
        event_count=len(all_events),
    ) as calendar_info_span:
        event_calendar_info = {}
        for event in all_events:
            cal: InternalCalendar | ExternalCalendarAccount | None = None
            is_internal = False

            if event.internal_calendar_id:
                cal = internal_calendars_dict.get(event.internal_calendar_id)
                is_internal = True
            elif event.is_external and event.calendar_id:
                cal = external_calendars_dict.get(
                    str(event.calendar_id)
                ) or external_calendars_dict.get(event.calendar_id)

            if cal:
                event_calendar_info[event.id] = {
                    "type": cal.type,
                    "sports_subcategory": cal.sports_subcategory,
                    "is_internal": is_internal,
                    "associated_users": _build_calendar_users(cal),
                }
            else:
                event_calendar_info[event.id] = {}

@login_required
def event_detail(request, event_id):
    """
    View details of a specific event
    """
    with child_span("web.events.detail.load_event_data") as load_span:
        event = get_object_or_404(
            # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
            Event.objects.prefetch_related("participants"),
            pk=event_id,
        )  # Use pk for UUID

        # Check if user has access to this event
        if not has_event_access(request.user, event):
            return HttpResponseForbidden(
                "You don't have permission to view this event."
            )

        # Get participant status for the current user
        try:
            participant = EventParticipant.objects.get(event=event, user=request.user)
        except EventParticipant.DoesNotExist:
            participant = None

        # Get all participants
        participants = event.participants.all()

        # Get tasks
        tasks = event.tasks.all()

        # Get polls
        polls = event.polls.all()

        # Get expenses
        expenses = event.expenses.all()

        # Get notes
        notes = event.notes.filter(
            Q(is_private=False) | Q(author=request.user)
        ).order_by("-is_pinned", "-created_at")
        set_span_attributes(
            load_span,
            has_internal_calendar=bool(event.internal_calendar_id),
            is_external=event.is_external,
        )

    # Fetch calendar information for the event
    from calendars.models import InternalCalendar

    with child_span("web.events.detail.load_calendar_info") as calendar_span:
        # Create dictionary to store calendar information
        event_calendar_info = {}

        # Get internal calendar information
        if event.internal_calendar_id:
            try:
                internal_calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.get(
                    id=event.internal_calendar_id
                )
                event_calendar_info = {
                    "type": internal_calendar.type,
                    "sports_subcategory": internal_calendar.sports_subcategory,
                    "is_internal": True,
                }

                # Get associated users for internal calendar (skip inactive)
                associated_users = [
                    u for u in internal_calendar.associated_users.all() if u.is_active
                ]
                if associated_users:
                    event_calendar_info["associated_users"] = [  # type: ignore[assignment]
                        {"id": user.id, "name": user.get_full_name() or user.username}
                        for user in associated_users
                    ]

            except InternalCalendar.DoesNotExist:
                pass
        # Get external calendar information
        elif event.is_external and event.external_source:
            try:
                external_calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(
                    calendar_id=event.calendar_id
                )
                event_calendar_info = {
                    "type": external_calendar.type,
                    "sports_subcategory": external_calendar.sports_subcategory,
                    "is_internal": False,
                    "external_calendar_name": external_calendar.account_name,
                }

                # Get associated users for external calendar (skip inactive)
                associated_users = [
                    u for u in external_calendar.associated_users.all() if u.is_active
                ]
                if associated_users:
                    event_calendar_info["associated_users"] = [  # type: ignore[assignment]
                        {"id": user.id, "name": user.get_full_name() or user.username}
                        for user in associated_users
                    ]

            except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
                pass
        associated_users_for_span = event_calendar_info.get("associated_users")
        set_span_attributes(
            calendar_span,
            has_calendar_info=bool(event_calendar_info),
            associated_user_count=(
                len(associated_users_for_span)
                if isinstance(associated_users_for_span, list)
                else 0
            ),
        )

    user_reminder = EventReminder.objects.filter(event=event, user=request.user).first()

    # Get invitations for organizers
    invitations = []
    invitations_by_status: dict[str, list] = {}
    is_organizer = is_event_organizer(request.user, event)
    if is_organizer:
        invitations = list(event.invitations.all().order_by("-created_at"))
        # Group invitations by status
        invitations_by_status = {
            "ACCEPTED": [],
            "PENDING": [],
            "DECLINED": [],
            "EXPIRED": [],
            "REVOKED": [],
        }
        for inv in invitations:
            if inv.status in invitations_by_status:
                invitations_by_status[inv.status].append(inv)

    # Calculate total accepted guests including +1s
    total_accepted_guests: int = sum(
        1 + (inv.plus_one_count or 0)
        for inv in invitations_by_status.get("ACCEPTED", [])
    )

    with child_span("web.events.detail.build_context") as context_span:
        context = {
            "event": event,
            "participant": participant,
            "participants": participants,
            "tasks": tasks,
            "polls": polls,
            "expenses": expenses,
            "notes": notes,
            "is_organizer": is_organizer,
            "event_calendar_info": event_calendar_info,
            "user_reminder": user_reminder,
            "invitations": invitations,
            "invitations_by_status": invitations_by_status,
            "total_accepted_guests": total_accepted_guests,
            "debug": True,  # Add debug flag
        }
        set_span_attributes(
            context_span,
            invitation_count=len(invitations),
            accepted_guest_count=total_accepted_guests,
        )

    with child_span(
        "web.events.detail.render_template",
        template_name="events/event_detail.html",
    ):
        return render(request, "events/event_detail.html", context)


@login_required
def event_create(request):
    """
    Create a new event
    """
    if request.method == "POST":
        # Handle audience type conversion to visibility
        post_data = request.POST.copy()
        audience_type = post_data.get("audience_type")

        if audience_type:
            # Convert audience selection to visibility
            if audience_type == "personal":
                post_data["visibility"] = "PERSONAL"
                post_data["family_group"] = ""
            elif audience_type == "family":
                post_data["visibility"] = "PUBLIC"
                # Set family_group from family_group_option if provided
                family_group_id = post_data.get("family_group_option")
                if family_group_id and family_group_id != "none":
                    post_data["family_group"] = family_group_id
            elif audience_type == "specific":
                post_data["visibility"] = "PRIVATE"
                post_data["family_group"] = ""

        form = EventForm(post_data, user=request.user)

        # Handle save as draft
        if "save_draft" in request.POST:
            if form.is_valid():
                event = form.save(commit=False)
                event.creator = request.user

                # Set family group if provided
                family_id = form.cleaned_data.get("family_group")
                if family_id:
                    event.family_group_id = family_id

                # Handle calendar selection
                internal_calendar_id = post_data.get("internal_calendar")
                if internal_calendar_id:
                    try:
                        calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.get(
                            id=internal_calendar_id, user=request.user
                        )
                        event.internal_calendar = calendar
                    except InternalCalendar.DoesNotExist:
                        pass

                event.save()

                # Add creator as participant
                EventParticipant.objects.create(
                    event=event, user=request.user, rsvp_status="YES", is_organizer=True
                )

                messages.info(
                    request, "Event saved as draft. You can continue editing."
                )
                return redirect("event_edit", event_id=event.id)

        if form.is_valid():
            # Create the event
            event = form.save(commit=False)
            event.creator = request.user

            # Set family group if provided
            family_id = form.cleaned_data.get("family_group")
            if family_id:
                event.family_group_id = family_id

            # Handle simplified calendar selection (no more "new" option)
            internal_calendar_id = post_data.get("internal_calendar")
            if internal_calendar_id:
                try:
                    calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.get(
                        id=internal_calendar_id, user=request.user
                    )
                    event.internal_calendar = calendar
                except InternalCalendar.DoesNotExist:
                    messages.warning(request, "Selected calendar does not exist.")

            event.save()

            # Add creator as a participant and organizer
            EventParticipant.objects.create(
                event=event, user=request.user, rsvp_status="YES", is_organizer=True
            )

            # Add participants if provided
            participant_ids = post_data.getlist("participants")
            for user_id in participant_ids:
                if user_id != str(request.user.id):  # Skip creator, already added
                    EventParticipant.objects.create(
                        event=event, user_id=user_id, rsvp_status="PENDING"
                    )

            messages.success(request, "Event created successfully!")
            return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)
    else:
        # Check if a date parameter was provided
        date_str = request.GET.get("date")
        initial_data = {}

        if date_str:
            try:
                # Parse the date string
                date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()

                # Set default start time to 9:00 AM on the selected date
                start_time = datetime.combine(
                    date_obj, datetime.min.time().replace(hour=9)
                )

                # Set default end time to 10:00 AM on the selected date
                end_time = datetime.combine(
                    date_obj, datetime.min.time().replace(hour=10)
                )

                # Set initial values for the form
                initial_data = {"start_time": start_time, "end_time": end_time}
            except ValueError:
                # If date parsing fails, don't set initial values
                pass

        form = EventForm(initial=initial_data, user=request.user)

    # Get user's family groups for the form
    family_groups = FamilyGroup.objects.filter(memberships__user=request.user)

    # Get potential participants (family members)
    family_ids = request.user.family_memberships.values_list("family_id", flat=True)
    potential_participants = (
        User.objects.filter(family_memberships__family_id__in=family_ids)
        .distinct()
        .exclude(id=request.user.id)
    )

    context = {
        "form": form,
        "family_groups": family_groups,
        "potential_participants": potential_participants,
        "google_places_api_key": getattr(settings, "GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY", ""),
    }

    return render(request, "events/event_form.html", context)


@login_required
def event_edit(request, event_id):
    """
    Edit an existing event
    """
    event = get_object_or_404(Event, pk=event_id)  # Use pk for UUID

    # Check if user is allowed to edit this event
    if not is_event_organizer(request.user, event):
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You don't have permission to edit this event.")

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = EventForm(request.POST, instance=event, user=request.user)
        if form.is_valid():
            # Don't save the form yet, we might need to update the calendar
            updated_event = form.save(commit=False)

            # Handle calendar selection
            calendar_option = request.POST.get(  # nosemgrep -- auxiliary POST fields validated by form logic
                "calendar_option"
            )

            if calendar_option == "new":
                # Create a new calendar
                calendar_name = request.POST.get("new_calendar_name")
                calendar_color = request.POST.get("new_calendar_color", "#4285F4")
                calendar_type = request.POST.get("new_calendar_type", "GENERAL")
                sports_subcategory = None

                if calendar_type == "SPORTS":
                    sports_subcategory = request.POST.get(
                        "new_calendar_sports_subcategory"
                    )

                if calendar_name:
                    # Import the InternalCalendar model
                    from calendars.models import (
                        InternalCalendar,
                        InternalCalendarVisibility,
                    )

                    # Create the calendar
                    calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.create(
                        user=request.user,
                        name=calendar_name,
                        description=f"Created for event: {updated_event.title}",
                        color=calendar_color,
                        type=calendar_type,
                        sports_subcategory=sports_subcategory,
                        is_active=True,
                    )

                    # Associate the user with their own calendar by default
                    calendar.associated_users.add(request.user)

                    # Create default visibility settings
                    InternalCalendarVisibility.objects.create(calendar=calendar)

                    # Associate the event with the new calendar
                    updated_event.internal_calendar = calendar

                    messages.success(
                        request, f'Calendar "{calendar_name}" created successfully!'
                    )
                else:
                    messages.warning(
                        request, "Calendar name is required to create a new calendar."
                    )
            elif calendar_option == "existing":
                # Use existing calendar if selected
                internal_calendar_id = request.POST.get("internal_calendar")
                if internal_calendar_id:
                    from calendars.models import InternalCalendar

                    try:
                        calendar = InternalCalendar.objects.get(
                            id=internal_calendar_id, user=request.user
                        )
                        updated_event.internal_calendar = calendar
                    except InternalCalendar.DoesNotExist:
                        messages.warning(request, "Selected calendar does not exist.")
            elif calendar_option == "none":
                # Remove calendar association
                updated_event.internal_calendar = None

            # Set family group if visibility is PUBLIC
            family_id = form.cleaned_data.get("family_group")
            if updated_event.visibility == "PUBLIC" and family_id:
                updated_event.family_group_id = family_id
            elif updated_event.visibility != "PUBLIC":
                updated_event.family_group = None

            # Save the updated event
            updated_event.save()

            # Update participants if provided
            participant_ids = request.POST.getlist("participants")

            # Get current participants
            current_participants = set(
                event.participants.values_list("user_id", flat=True)
            )
            new_participants = set(map(int, participant_ids))

            # Add new participants
            for user_id in new_participants - current_participants:
                if user_id != request.user.id:  # Skip creator
                    EventParticipant.objects.create(
                        event=event, user_id=user_id, rsvp_status="PENDING"
                    )

            # Remove participants that were deselected
            # Note: We don't remove the creator or organizers
            organizer_ids = event.participants.filter(is_organizer=True).values_list(
                "user_id", flat=True
            )
            for user_id in current_participants - new_participants:
                if user_id != event.creator.id and user_id not in organizer_ids:
                    EventParticipant.objects.filter(
                        event=event, user_id=user_id
                    ).delete()

            messages.success(request, "Event updated successfully!")
            return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)
    else:
        form = EventForm(instance=event, user=request.user)

    # Get user's family groups for the form
    family_groups = FamilyGroup.objects.filter(memberships__user=request.user)

    # Get potential participants (family members)
    family_ids = request.user.family_memberships.values_list("family_id", flat=True)
    potential_participants = (
        User.objects.filter(family_memberships__family_id__in=family_ids)
        .distinct()
        .exclude(id=request.user.id)
    )

    # Get current participants
    current_participant_ids = list(event.participants.values_list("user_id", flat=True))

    context = {
        "form": form,
        "event": event,
        "family_groups": family_groups,
        "potential_participants": potential_participants,
        "current_participant_ids": current_participant_ids,
        "google_places_api_key": getattr(settings, "GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY", ""),
    }

    return render(request, "events/event_form.html", context)


@login_required
def event_delete(request, event_id):
    """
    Delete an event
    """
    event = get_object_or_404(Event, pk=event_id)  # Use pk for UUID

    # Check if user is allowed to delete this event
    if not is_event_organizer(request.user, event):
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You don't have permission to delete this event.")

    if request.method == "POST":
        # If this is an external event, track it to prevent re-syncing
        if event.is_external and event.external_id and event.calendar_id:
            from calendars.models import DeletedExternalEvent, ExternalCalendarAccount

            # Get the calendar object using calendar_id
            try:
                calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(
                    calendar_id=event.calendar_id
                )
                # Create a record to prevent re-syncing
                DeletedExternalEvent.objects.create(
                    calendar=calendar, external_id=event.external_id
                )
            except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
                # Log the error but continue with deletion
                logger.warning(
                    f"Could not find ExternalCalendarAccount with calendar_id: {event.calendar_id}"
                )

        event.delete()
        messages.success(request, "Event deleted successfully!")
        return redirect("event_list")

    context = {
        "event": event,
    }

    return render(request, "events/event_confirm_delete.html", context)

@require_POST
def poll_vote(request, poll_id):
    """
    Vote on a poll
    """
    poll = get_object_or_404(Poll, id=poll_id)
    event = poll.event

    # Check if user has access to this event
    if not has_event_access(request.user, event):
        return HttpResponseForbidden("You don't have permission to view this event.")

    # Check if the poll is closed
    if poll.closes_at and poll.closes_at < timezone.now():
        messages.error(request, "This poll is closed")
        return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)

    # Get the option ID(s)
    option_ids = request.POST.getlist("option")
    if not option_ids:
        messages.error(request, "No options selected")
        return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)

    # For single-choice polls, ensure only one option is selected
    if not poll.multiple_choice and len(option_ids) > 1:
        messages.error(request, "This poll only allows a single choice")
        return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)

    # Verify all options belong to this poll
    options = PollOption.objects.filter(id__in=option_ids, poll=poll)
    if len(options) != len(option_ids):
        messages.error(request, "Invalid poll options")
        return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)

    # Remove existing votes by this user for this poll
    PollVote.objects.filter(poll=poll, user=request.user).delete()

    # Create new votes
    for option in options:
        PollVote.objects.create(poll=poll, option=option, user=request.user)

    messages.success(request, "Vote recorded successfully!")
    return redirect("event_detail", event_id=event.id)

def is_event_organizer(user, event):
    """
    Check if a user is an organizer for an event
    """
    # Staff can organize all events
    if user.is_staff:
        return True

    # Creator is always an organizer
    if event.creator == user:
        return True

    # Check if user is an explicit organizer
    if EventParticipant.objects.filter(
        event=event, user=user, is_organizer=True
    ).exists():
        return True

    # Family admins (PARENT role) can edit family events
    if event.family_group_id:
        from users.models import FamilyMembership

        if FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=user, family_id=event.family_group_id, role="PARENT"
        ).exists():
            return True

    return False

def event_bulk_edit(request):
    """

    """
